थिएटर्स में पूरे 30 दिन बिताने के बाद सुपरस्टार Rajinikanth की Jailer 2 ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है! 💥

Kollywood की यह एक्शन-कॉमेडी थ्रिलर हाल ही में Prime Video पर भी स्ट्रीम हो चुकी है, जिसके बाद अब थिएटर में इसका रन अंतिम चरण पर है। 350 crore के भारी बजट में बनी इस फिल्म ने 30 दिनों में भारत में 473.44 crore net (558.68 crore gross) की शानदार कमाई की है और यह भारत में Kollywood की सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली फिल्म बन चुकी है। 🎬

ओवरसीज मार्केट में 275.1 crore gross बटोरे गए हैं, जिसके साथ ही फिल्म का 30 दिनों का वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन 833.78 crore gross तक पहुंच गया है। 123.44 crore यानी 35.27% ROI के साथ Jailer 2 ने 'प्लस' वर्डिक्ट हासिल कर लिया है और अब यह 835-838 crore के लाइफटाइम कलेक्शन की तरफ बढ़ रही है। 🚀

क्या आपने Thalaivar Rajinikanth की यह ब्लॉकबस्टर थिएटर्स में देखी या फिर Prime Video पर देखने वाले हैं? कमेंट्स में हमें जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Jailer 2 Box Office: Rajinikanth Starrer Completes One Month In Theaters – Here’s Its Budget, Collection & Verdict!
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has finished its glorious 30-day run at the box office, grossing a whopping 830 crore+ worldwide. 
 The post  Jailer 2 Box Office: Rajinikanth Starrer Completes One Month In Theaters – Here’s Its Budget, Collection & Verdict!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth ‘s Jailer 2, after emerging as an industry hit for Kollywood, has entered the final stage of its run. Recently, it premiered on Prime Video, which will further impact its run. Amid this, the film has finished its one-month run in theaters. During this period, it has fetched massive numbers both in India and overseas. At the worldwide box office, it has earned a whopping 830 crore+. Keep reading to find out where the film exactly stands after 30 days!
The Kollywood action-comedy thriller earned 39 lakh on its fifth Friday, taking its 30-day total to 473.44 crore net (all languages) at the Indian box office. It equals 558.68 crore in gross collections. With this, it is Kollywood’s highest-grossing film in India by a big margin.
Week 1 – 334.35 crore (8-day) Week 2 – 95.55 crore Week 3 – 37.4 crore Week 4 – 5.75 crore Day 30 – 39 lakh
Jailer 2 was made at an estimated budget of 350 crore and has earned 473.44 crore net at the Indian box office so far. So, in 30 days, it has recorded a return on investment (ROI) of 123.44 crore , or 35.27% . Based on ROI, the film has secured a plus verdict.
As mentioned above, Jailer 2 has grossed 558.68 crore in India. Overseas, it has grossed 275.1 crore so far. Overall, the film has earned a staggering 833.78 crore gross at the worldwide box office in 30 days. Considering the slow pace, the film won’t add much from here and is heading for a lifetime collection of 835-838 crore gross.
